c.t: 1. For the buttercream custard: In a 2800 ml stainless-steel saucier, bring the milk and vanilla bean to a simmer over medium heat. When it begins to bubble, turn off the heat, cover, and steep for 30 minutes (or refrigerate, covered, for up to 24 hours). Meanwhile, whisk the sugar and cornstarch together in a medium bowl, then whisk in the eggs.

2. Return the milk to a simmer; scrape the pulp from the vanilla bean into the milk and discard the pod. Whisk 120 ml of the hot milk into the eggs; repeat with a second and a third ladleful, then pour the warmed eggs into the pot. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thick and lumpy, about 3 minutes; once it bubbles sluggishly, keep cooking and whisking for 2 full minutes more, until smooth.

3. Off the heat, stir in the vanilla extract, then pour the custard into a large baking dish, press plastic wrap against the surface, and refrigerate until thick and cooled to about 20 °C, about 1 hour (or up to 1 week; let it warm back to about 20 °C before using).

4. For the buttercream: In a stand mixer fitted with the paddle, beat the cream cheese and butter on medium speed until fluffy and light, about 5 minutes. Stir the custard into a thick, dough-like mass. Scrape the bowl, switch to the whisk, and whip on medium speed, adding the custard a few tbsp at a time; then drizzle in the lemon juice and, if you like, a pinch of salt. Scrape the bowl and whip a few seconds more; the buttercream should be light and creamy but thick enough to hang from a spoon.

5. Use the buttercream right away, or seal it in a zipper-lock bag and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks or freeze for up to several months; rewarm to about 22 °C and re-whip before using. If it seems stiff or greasy, melt about 235 ml of it in the microwave (about 30 seconds) and whip it back in on medium-high for 15 seconds; if it seems loose, refrigerate the bowl for 15 minutes, then whip on medium-high for 3 minutes.

6. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Grease two 20 cm round cake pans with butter and cover the bottom with a round of parchment paper. Lightly dust the insides of the cake pans with cocoa powder and discard any excess by tapping the pans upside down. (For cupcakes, line a muffin pan with baking cups.)
7. In a medium bowl, sift the flour, 50 g cocoa, and baking soda together and lightly whisk to combine. Set aside.

8. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, salt, and vanilla extract on low speed to roughly incorporate; then increase speed to medium and beat until soft, fluffy, and pale, 5 to 7 minutes, using a flexible spatula to scrape as needed.

9. With the mixer running on its lowest speed, drizzle in the food coloring (if using). Gradually increase the speed to medium and mix until the coloring is evenly distributed, about 30 seconds, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl if needed. With the mixer on low speed, add the eggs one by one, briefly increasing the mixer speed after each addition until each egg is fully incorporated. Once fully mixed, stop mixer and use a flexible spatula to scrape down the sides of the bowl.

10. Add a third of the flour-cocoa mixture to the butter-egg mixture, then start mixer on low speed and gradually increase to medium speed, until no dry flour remains, about 30 seconds. On low speed, slowly add a third of the buttermilk and beat until fully incorporated, about 30 seconds. Scrape down the bowl as needed, and repeat adding and alternating with half of the remaining flour mixture, half of the remaining buttermilk, then finally the remaining flour mixture, and the remaining buttermilk. With a rubber spatula, scrape the paddle clean and give the batter a final stir, making sure to scrape the bottom of the bowl.

11. For Cupcakes: Line standard-size muffin pan with baking-cup liners. Distribute the batter evenly among the baking cups so each is about 3/4 full. Bake for 24 to 26 minutes, or until a tester comes out clean. Repeat with remaining batter. Let cool completely before frosting. Once cool, use an offset spatula to spread the frosting on top of each cupcake.

12. For a Layer Cake: Scrape the batter into the prepared pans and bake until a toothpick or cake tester inserted into cake center comes out clean, 25 to 30 minutes. Cool cakes in their pans on a cooling rack for 15 minutes. Run an offset spatula or butter knife around edges of cakes, then invert cake onto a plate and transfer back to the rack to cool completely, at least 1 hour.

13. To Crumb Coat the Cake: Using a serrated knife, level cakes. Place one layer on a turntable. If you like, a waxed cardboard cake round can first be placed underneath, secured to the turntable with a scrap of damp paper towel. Top with 235 ml frosting, using an offset spatula to spread it evenly from edge to edge. Top with the second layer and cover the sides of the cake with 235 ml frosting, spread into an even and smooth layer. Refrigerate cake until frosting is firm to the touch, about 30 minutes.
14. To Finish the Cake: Spread the top and sides of the cake with the remaining frosting to decorate as desired. Allow the cake to come to room temperature before serving.

1. Vanilkový krém do krému: v 2,8-litrovom nerezovom rendlíku privedieme na strednom ohni mlieko s vanilkovým strukom k miernemu varu. Keď začne bublať, oheň vypneme, prikryjeme a necháme 30 minút lúhovať (alebo prikryté v chladničke až 24 hodín). Medzitým v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame cukor s kukuričným škrobom a potom zašľaháme vajcia.

2. Mlieko znova privedieme k miernemu varu; do mlieka vyškrabeme dužinu z vanilkového struku a struk vyhodíme. Do vajec zašľaháme 120 ml horúceho mlieka; zopakujeme s druhou a treťou naberačkou, potom zohriate vajcia vlejeme do hrnca. Za stáleho šľahania varíme na strednom ohni, kým zmes nie je hustá a hrudkovitá, asi 3 minúty; keď začne lenivo bublať, varíme a šľaháme ešte celé 2 minúty, kým nie je hladká.

3. Mimo ohňa vmiešame vanilkový extrakt, krém nalejeme do veľkej zapekacej misy, na povrch pritlačíme fóliu a necháme v chladničke, kým nezhustne a nevychladne na asi 20 °C, asi 1 hodinu (alebo až 1 týždeň; pred použitím ho necháme zohriať späť na asi 20 °C).

4. Krém: v kuchynskom robote s plochým miešadlom šľaháme krémový syr s maslom na strednej rýchlosti do nadýchanej a ľahkej hmoty, asi 5 minút. Vanilkový krém premiešame na hustú hmotu podobnú cestu. Zotrieme misu, vymeníme miešadlo za metlu a šľaháme na strednej rýchlosti, pričom po niekoľkých lyžiciach pridávame vanilkový krém; potom prilejeme citrónovú šťavu a podľa chuti štipku soli. Zotrieme misu a šľaháme ešte niekoľko sekúnd; krém má byť ľahký a krémový, ale dosť hustý, aby visel z lyžice.

5. Krém použijeme hneď, alebo ho uzavrieme do uzatvárateľného vrecka a uchováme v chladničke až 2 týždne alebo v mrazničke až niekoľko mesiacov; pred použitím ho zohrejeme na asi 22 °C a znova vyšľaháme. Ak sa zdá tuhý alebo mastný, asi 235 ml z neho roztopíme v mikrovlnnej rúre (asi 30 sekúnd) a 15 sekúnd ho zašľaháme späť na stredne vysokej rýchlosti; ak sa zdá riedky, misu dáme na 15 minút do chladničky a potom šľaháme 3 minúty na stredne vysokej rýchlosti.

6. Rošt v rúre posunieme do stredu a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Dve okrúhle tortové formy s priemerom 20 cm vymastíme maslom a dno vystelieme kruhom papiera na pečenie. Vnútro foriem zľahka poprášime kakaom a prebytok vyklepeme obrátením foriem. (Na cupcaky vystelieme formu na muffiny papierovými košíčkami.)
7. Do strednej misy preosejeme múku, 50 g kakaa a sódu bikarbónu a zľahka premiešame metličkou. Odložíme.

8. V mise kuchynského robota s plochým miešadlom šľaháme maslo, kryštálový cukor, hnedý cukor, soľ a vanilkový extrakt na nízkej rýchlosti, aby sa zhruba spojili; potom zvýšime na strednú rýchlosť a šľaháme, kým zmes nie je mäkká, nadýchaná a svetlá, 5 až 7 minút; podľa potreby zotierame ohybnou stierkou.

9. Za chodu robota na najnižšej rýchlosti prilejeme potravinárske farbivo (ak ho používame). Rýchlosť postupne zvýšime na strednú a miešame, kým sa farbivo rovnomerne nerozptýli, asi 30 sekúnd; podľa potreby zastavíme a zotrieme steny misy. Na nízkej rýchlosti pridávame po jednom vajcia; po každom krátko zvýšime rýchlosť, kým sa vajce úplne nezapracuje. Keď je všetko premiešané, robot zastavíme a ohybnou stierkou zotrieme steny misy.

10. K maslovo-vaječnej zmesi pridáme tretinu múčno-kakaovej zmesi, robot spustíme na nízkej rýchlosti a postupne zvýšime na strednú, kým nezostane žiadna suchá múka, asi 30 sekúnd. Na nízkej rýchlosti pomaly prilejeme tretinu cmaru a šľaháme, kým sa úplne nezapracuje, asi 30 sekúnd. Podľa potreby zotrieme misu a striedavo pridáme polovicu zvyšnej múčnej zmesi, polovicu zvyšného cmaru, potom zvyšnú múčnu zmes a nakoniec zvyšný cmar. Gumenou stierkou očistíme miešadlo a cesto naposledy premiešame; nezabudneme zotrieť dno misy.

11. Cupcaky: štandardnú formu na muffiny vystelieme papierovými košíčkami. Cesto rovnomerne rozdelíme do košíčkov, každý asi do 3/4. Pečieme 24 až 26 minút, kým skúšobná ihla nevyjde čistá. Zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom. Pred potretím necháme úplne vychladnúť. Vychladnuté cupcaky potrieme navrchu krémom pomocou zahnutej stierky.

12. Torta: cesto zotrieme do pripravených foriem a pečieme, kým špáradlo alebo skúšobná ihla zapichnutá do stredu nevyjde čistá, 25 až 30 minút. Pláty necháme 15 minút chladnúť vo formách na mriežke. Po okrajoch prejdeme zahnutou stierkou alebo nožom na maslo, plát vyklopíme na tanier a preložíme späť na mriežku, kde ho necháme úplne vychladnúť, aspoň 1 hodinu.

13. Základná vrstva krému: pláty zarovnáme zúbkovaným nožom. Jeden plát položíme na otočný stojan. Ak chceme, môžeme podeň najprv dať voskovanú kartónovú tortovú podložku a prichytiť ju k stojanu kúskom vlhkej papierovej utierky. Navrch dáme 235 ml krému a zahnutou stierkou ho rovnomerne roztrieme od okraja po okraj. Položíme druhý plát a boky torty pokryjeme 235 ml krému v rovnomernej a hladkej vrstve. Tortu necháme v chladničke, kým krém nie je na dotyk pevný, asi 30 minút.
14. Dokončenie torty: vrch a boky torty potrieme zvyšným krémom a ozdobíme podľa chuti. Pred podávaním necháme tortu zohriať na izbovú teplotu.

cat.en: Use natural cocoa, not Dutch-processed: its acidity reacts with the baking soda and buttermilk to leaven the cake, and its lighter colour keeps the cake red. 4 tsp liquid red food colouring can replace the gel paste.

en.t: 115 g light brown sugar (packed)
70 g whole wheat flour (spooned)
1 tbsp (5 g) ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp (1 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight
Shy 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground cardamom
55 g unsalted butter (about 4 tbsp), soft, about 21 °C
395 g plain or quick-toasted sugar
170 g unsalted butter (about 12 tbsp), about 18 °C
4 tsp (16 g) baking powder
1 tsp (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight
15 g vanilla extract (1 tbsp (15 ml))
3 large eggs, brought to about 20 °C (about 150 g)
340 g all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal (spooned)
395 g plain Greek yogurt, any percentage will do, brought to about 20 °C

1. For the Topping: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine brown sugar, whole wheat flour, cinnamon, salt, cardamom, and butter. Mix on low speed until sandy and well combined. Scrape onto a large plate or sheet of parchment. Alternatively, the crumb topping can be transferred to an airtight container and refrigerated for up to 1 week, or frozen for 6 months. Wipe bowl and paddle with a paper towel and proceed to the next step—no need to wash!

2. For the Coffee Cake: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine sugar, butter, baking powder, salt, and vanilla. Mix on low to moisten, then increase speed to medium and cream until soft and light, about 10 minutes. Pause to scrape bowl and beater with a flexible spatula, then resume mixing on medium speed. Add eggs one at a time, allowing each to fully incorporate before adding the next.

3. Scrape bowl and beater with a flexible spatula, then resume mixing on low. Sprinkle in about 1/3 of flour, then add 1/3 of Greek yogurt. Repeat with remaining flour and yogurt, working in thirds as before. Fold batter once or twice with a flexible spatula, then scrape into a parchment-lined 23 × 33 × 5 cm anodized-aluminum baking pan. Spread in an even layer, then cover with prepared topping, a handful at a time, squeezing each addition in your palm to help form streusel nuggets.

4. Bake until coffee cake is puffed and firm, about 40 minutes (a toothpick inserted into the center should emerge with a few moist crumbs). Cool cake directly in pan about 30 minutes before serving, as it will be soft and gummy until its crumb has had a chance to set. Cut into squares with a butter knife and lift parchment to help fit an angled spatula under the first slice. To keep coffee cake as fresh as possible, cut only as much as you plan to serve at one time. With plastic wrap or wax paper pressed against cut surface, and top of pan covered with a sheet of aluminum foil, leftovers will keep up to 3 days at room temperature.

1. Posýpka: v mise kuchynského robota s plochým miešadlom spojíme hnedý cukor, celozrnnú múku, škoricu, soľ, kardamóm a maslo. Na nízkej rýchlosti miešame, kým zmes nie je piesočnatá a dobre spojená. Zotrieme ju na veľký tanier alebo papier na pečenie. Posýpku môžeme aj preložiť do vzduchotesnej nádoby a uchovať v chladničke až 1 týždeň alebo v mrazničke 6 mesiacov. Misu a miešadlo utrieme papierovou utierkou a pokračujeme ďalším krokom – netreba ich umývať!

2. Koláč: rošt v rúre posunieme do dolnej strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). V mise kuchynského robota s plochým miešadlom spojíme cukor, maslo, prášok do pečiva, soľ a vanilku. Na nízkej rýchlosti premiešame, aby sa navlhčili, potom zvýšime na strednú rýchlosť a šľaháme do mäkkej a ľahkej hmoty, asi 10 minút. Zastavíme, misu aj miešadlo zotrieme ohybnou stierkou a pokračujeme na strednej rýchlosti. Pridávame po jednom vajcia a každé necháme úplne zapracovať, kým pridáme ďalšie.

3. Misu aj miešadlo zotrieme ohybnou stierkou a pokračujeme na nízkej rýchlosti. Vsypeme asi 1/3 múky, potom pridáme 1/3 gréckeho jogurtu. Zopakujeme so zvyšnou múkou a jogurtom, opäť po tretinách. Cesto raz či dvakrát premiešame ohybnou stierkou a zotrieme ho do plechu z eloxovaného hliníka 23 × 33 × 5 cm vystlaného papierom na pečenie. Rozotrieme do rovnomernej vrstvy a potom ho po hrstiach pokryjeme pripravenou posýpkou; každú hrsť stlačíme v dlani, aby vznikli hrudky drobenky.

4. Pečieme, kým nie je koláč nadýchaný a pevný, asi 40 minút (špáradlo zapichnuté do stredu má vyjsť s niekoľkými vlhkými omrvinkami). Koláč necháme pred podávaním chladnúť priamo v plechu asi 30 minút, pretože kým striedka nestuhne, je mäkký a gumovitý. Nožom na maslo nakrájame na štvorce a nadvihnutím papiera si pomôžeme podsunúť šikmú stierku pod prvý kúsok. Aby koláč zostal čo najčerstvejší, krájame len toľko, koľko naraz podávame. S fóliou alebo voskovaným papierom pritlačeným na rez a plechom prikrytým alobalom vydržia zvyšky pri izbovej teplote až 3 dni.

en.t: 4 tbsp (57 g) butter
106 g light brown sugar, packed
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground ginger
565 g can pineapple rings in juice, drained
candied red cherries or maraschino cherries
pecans or walnuts, halves or diced; optional
3 tbsp (43 g) butter, at room temperature, at least 20 °C
149 g granulated sugar
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell), at room temperature
1/2 tsp (3 g) table salt
1 3/4 tsp (7 g) baking powder
1 tsp (5 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) coconut extract, optional*
150 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
113 g milk, at room temperature
1. Preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Lightly grease a 23 cm round cake pan.
2. To make the topping: Melt the butter, and mix with the brown sugar, cinnamon, and ginger. Spoon the mixture into the prepared pan.
3. Space the pineapple rings atop the brown sugar mixture. Place a cherry in the center of each ring. If you're using nuts, scatter them in any empty spaces.
4. To make the cake: Beat the butter and sugar until fairly smooth.
5. Beat in the egg, then the salt, baking powder, vanilla, and coconut flavor.
6. Add the flour alternately with the milk, mixing at medium speed and beginning and ending with the flour. Once the last of the flour is added, mix briefly, just until smooth.
7. Spoon the thick batter into the prepared pan, spreading it to the edges of the pan. It may not cover the pineapple entirely; that's OK.
8. Bake the cake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick or thin knife inserted into the center comes out clean.

9. Remove the cake from the oven, wait 3 minutes, then turn the pan over onto a serving plate. Wait 30 seconds, then lift the pan off. If anything sticks in the pan, just lift it out and place it back on the cake.
10. Serve warm or at room temperature.

servT.en: 28, one 33 cm x 46 cm sheet cake
servT.sk: 28; jeden koláč na plech (33 cm × 46 cm)

en.t: 227 g semisweet chocolate wafers, chunks, chips, or chopped semisweet chocolate
4 tbsp (57 g) butter, room temperature
149 g vegetable oil
170 g water
43 g King Arthur Triple Cocoa Blend or Dutch-process cocoa
240 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
397 g granulated sugar
1/2 tsp (3 g) baking soda
1/2 tsp (3 g) table salt
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell), at room temperature
57 g buttermilk or yogurt, at room temperature
2 large egg yolks (≈36 g), at room temperature
2 tsp (10 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
340 g semisweet chocolate wafers, chunks, chips, or chopped semisweet chocolate
2 tbsp (43 g) light corn syrup
1 tsp (5 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
149 g heavy cream
113 g confectioners' sugar
43 g unsweetened cocoa, Dutch-process or natural
1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Grease a half-sheet pan (33 cm x 46 cm), line it with parchment, and grease the parchment.
2. To make the cake: Combine the chocolate, butter, oil, water, and cocoa in a medium saucepan or microwave-safe bowl.
3. Heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is smooth. Transfer it to a mixing bowl.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.
5. Add the dry ingredients to the chocolate mixture, stirring until just combined.
6. Mix together the buttermilk, eggs, yolks, and vanilla, then add to the other ingredients, again mixing until just combined.
7. Pour the batter into the prepared pan, spreading it into an even layer.
8. Bake the cake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean. Remove it from the oven, and allow it to cool completely in the pan.
9. To make the icing: Combine the chocolate, corn syrup, vanilla, and heavy cream in a microwave-safe bowl.
10. Microwave until the cream is very hot, and the chips have softened. Stir until the chips have melted and the mixture is smooth, reheating briefly if necessary.
11. Add the confectioners' sugar and cocoa, and beat until smooth.
12. Spread the icing evenly onto the cooled cake, and allow it to set for 30 to 60 minutes before serving.

305 g granulated sugar
2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract

2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract, for the buttercream
3/4 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume), for the buttercream
85 g heavy cream, straight from the fridge, for the buttercream
other extracts or gel-paste food colouring, to taste (optional), for the buttercream
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Place paper baking cups in two 12-cup (12-hole) muffin pans. Fit a piping bag with desired piping tip; set aside.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt to combine; set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together whole milk and sour cream until smooth; set aside.

3. In a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat butter and sugar together on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition, followed by the vanilla. Reduce speed to low and add about 1/4 of the flour mixture, then drizzle in 1/3 of milk and sour cream mixture. Beat at low speed until just blended after each addition. Repeat adding in increments, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Use a flexible spatula to scrape bowl, if necessary, and beat at low speed until combined, about 1 minute. Divide batter equally between baking cups, filling each about 2/3 of the way.

4. Bake until a wooden toothpick or cake tester inserted into center of cupcakes comes out clean and cupcakes spring back lightly when touched, about 18 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes, then remove cupcakes from pan and allow them to cool completely on wire rack, about 15 minutes.

5. For the buttercream: Put the butter in the bowl of a stand mixer and sift the powdered sugar on top. Using the paddle, mix on low until the sugar is fully incorporated. Add the vanilla and salt, increase to medium, and beat until airy and light, about 6 minutes, scraping the bowl as needed (it will warm to about 21 °C).
6. Reduce to low and drizzle in the cream. Scrape the bowl, then beat a few seconds more on medium. Adjust the salt and vanilla, or add other extracts or colouring as desired. Use immediately.

7. Using a flexible spatula, scrape buttercream into prepared piping bag. Pipe buttercream on top of each cupcake until completely covered. (Alternatively, use an offset spatula to spread buttercream on top of each cupcake until completely covered.) Repeat with remaining cupcakes.

c.t: 1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Place paper baking cups in two 12-cup (12-hole) muffin pans. Fit a piping bag with desired piping tip; set aside.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt to combine; set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together whole milk and sour cream until smooth; set aside.

3. In a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat butter and sugar together on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition, followed by the vanilla. Reduce speed to low and add about 1/4 of the flour mixture, then drizzle in 1/3 of milk and sour cream mixture. Beat at low speed until just blended after each addition. Repeat adding in increments, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Use a flexible spatula to scrape bowl, if necessary, and beat at low speed until combined, about 1 minute. Divide batter equally between baking cups, filling each about 2/3 of the way.

4. Bake until a wooden toothpick or cake tester inserted into center of cupcakes comes out clean and cupcakes spring back lightly when touched, about 18 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes, then remove cupcakes from pan and allow them to cool completely on wire rack, about 15 minutes.

5. For the buttercream: Put the butter in the bowl of a stand mixer and sift the powdered sugar on top. Using the paddle, mix on low until the sugar is fully incorporated. Add the vanilla and salt, increase to medium, and beat until airy and light, about 6 minutes, scraping the bowl as needed (it will warm to about 21 °C).
6. Reduce to low and drizzle in the cream. Scrape the bowl, then beat a few seconds more on medium. Adjust the salt and vanilla, or add other extracts or colouring as desired. Use immediately.

7. Using a flexible spatula, scrape buttercream into prepared piping bag. Pipe buttercream on top of each cupcake until completely covered. (Alternatively, use an offset spatula to spread buttercream on top of each cupcake until completely covered.) Repeat with remaining cupcakes.

1. Rošt v rúre posunieme do stredu a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Do dvoch foriem na 12 muffinov (12 jamiek) vložíme papierové košíčky. Cukrárske vrecko nasadíme na požadovanú špičku; odložíme.
2. V strednej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, prášok do pečiva a soľ; odložíme. V malej mise metličkou vymiešame plnotučné mlieko s kyslou smotanou dohladka; odložíme.

3. V kuchynskom robote s plochým miešadlom šľaháme maslo s cukrom na strednej rýchlosti do ľahkej a nadýchanej hmoty, asi 4 minúty. Po jednom pridávame vajcia a po každom dobre vyšľaháme, potom pridáme vanilku. Znížime rýchlosť na nízku a pridáme asi 1/4 múčnej zmesi, potom prilejeme 1/3 zmesi mlieka a kyslej smotany. Po každom pridaní šľaháme na nízkej rýchlosti, len kým sa nespojí. Pokračujeme po dávkach; začíname aj končíme múčnou zmesou. Ak treba, misu zotrieme ohybnou stierkou a šľaháme na nízkej rýchlosti, kým sa nespojí, asi 1 minútu. Cesto rovnomerne rozdelíme do košíčkov, každý asi do 2/3.

4. Pečieme, kým drevené špáradlo alebo skúšobná ihla zapichnutá do stredu cupcakov nevyjde čistá a cupcaky pri dotyku zľahka nepružia, asi 18 minút. Preložíme na mriežku. Necháme 10 minút chladnúť vo forme, potom cupcaky vyberieme z formy a necháme úplne vychladnúť na mriežke, asi 15 minút.

5. Krém: maslo dáme do misy kuchynského robota a navrch preosejeme práškový cukor. Plochým miešadlom miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, kým sa cukor úplne nezapracuje. Pridáme vanilku a soľ, zvýšime na strednú rýchlosť a šľaháme do vzdušnej a ľahkej hmoty, asi 6 minút; podľa potreby zotierame misu (krém sa zohreje na asi 21 °C).

6. Znížime na nízku rýchlosť a prilejeme smotanu. Zotrieme misu a na strednej rýchlosti šľaháme ešte niekoľko sekúnd. Dochutíme soľou a vanilkou, prípadne podľa chuti pridáme iné extrakty alebo farbivo. Hneď použijeme.

7. Krém ohybnou stierkou preložíme do pripraveného cukrárskeho vrecka. Na každý cupcake nastriekame krém, kým nie je celý vrch pokrytý. (Prípadne krém roztrieme zahnutou stierkou, kým nie je vrch každého cupcaku celý pokrytý.) Zopakujeme so zvyšnými cupcakmi.

en.t: 4 large eggs (≈200 g without shell), room temperature
300 g granulated sugar
173 g cake flour, plus more for dusting
2 tsp (8 g) baking powder
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
180 ml half-and-half
56 g (4 tbsp) unsalted butter, plus more for pans
50 g granulated sugar
60 ml water
227 g coarsely chopped dark chocolate, between 64 and 70% cacao
240 ml heavy cream
1 tsp (5 ml) light corn syrup
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
14 g (1 tbsp) unsalted butter, cubed, at room temperature
1 recipe vanilla pastry cream (see crème pâtissière, chapter 30)
1. Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Butter two 23 cm cake pans with unsalted butter, then dust with cake flour, shaking out excess.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together cake flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a small saucepan, heat half-and-half and butter over medium-low heat until butter has melted, about 3 minutes.

4. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, whip eggs and granulated sugar on medium-high speed until yolks are thick and pale yellow color, and doubled in volume, 5 to 7 minutes.
5. Reduce mixer speed to low, and slowly pour in half-and-half mixture. Continue to whisk until combined, about 15 seconds.

6. With the mixer on low speed, gradually add the dry mixture 59 ml at a time, until just incorporated, about 2 minutes. Using a flexible spatula, scrape down sides and bottom of the bowl to ensure there are no dry bits. (If any remain, use spatula to gently fold until incorporated.) Divide batter between prepared cake pans and, using an offset spatula, smooth surface. Gently tap cake pans on kitchen counter to eliminate any large air bubbles.

7. Bake, rotating halfway through, until cake has risen by about 2.5 cm, is light golden, and springs back when gently touched, 17 to 20 minutes. Transfer pans to a wire rack and allow cakes to cool in pans for 30 minutes.

8. Run an offset spatula or butter knife around the edges of cake, then carefully invert cake onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. Let cool completely, at least 30 minutes. (Cooled cake can be lightly wrapped in plastic wrap and stored at room temperature for up to 24 hours.)
9. For the Simple Syrup: In a small saucepan, bring sugar and water to a simmer over medium heat and cook, whisking, until sugar is fully dissolved, 5 to 7 minutes.

10. For the Chocolate Ganache: Place chocolate, heavy cream, corn syrup, and salt in a medium heatproof bowl. Set over a small saucepan of gently simmering water and heat, stirring occasionally, until chocolate is fully melted, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, stir to combine. Add butter and gently fold until ganache is smooth and shiny. Set aside until cool and slightly thickened (35 °C) but still fluid enough to pour, about 10 minutes.

11. To Assemble: Whisk pastry cream until smooth. Place one cake on a plate. Brush cake evenly with 1 to 2 tbsp (15–30 ml) simple syrup. Top with 475 ml pastry cream, using an offset spatula to spread it evenly from edge to edge. Top with the second cake and brush cake evenly with 1 to 2 tbsp (15–30 ml) simple syrup, allowing the cake to absorb it. Pour slightly thickened ganache over cake and, using an offset spatula, spread evenly to cover cake, letting excess ganache drip decoratively over the sides of the cake. Serve immediately or allow ganache to cool until firm.

1. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Dve tortové formy s priemerom 23 cm vymastíme nesoleným maslom a vysypeme hladkou múkou na pečivo; prebytok vytrasieme.
2. V strednej mise metličkou zmiešame múku na pečivo, prášok do pečiva a soľ.
3. V malom hrnci zohrievame na stredne miernom ohni smotanu so mliekom (half-and-half) a maslo, kým sa maslo neroztopí, asi 3 minúty.
4. V mise kuchynského robota s metlou šľaháme vajcia s kryštálovým cukrom na stredne vysokej rýchlosti, kým nie sú husté, svetložlté a nemajú dvojnásobný objem, 5 až 7 minút.
5. Znížime rýchlosť na nízku a pomaly prilejeme zmes smotany s maslom. Šľaháme, kým sa nespojí, asi 15 sekúnd.

6. Na nízkej rýchlosti postupne pridávame suchú zmes po 59 ml, len kým sa nezapracuje, asi 2 minúty. Ohybnou stierkou zotrieme steny a dno misy, aby nezostali suché kúsky. (Ak nejaké zostanú, jemne ich stierkou vmiešame.) Cesto rozdelíme do pripravených foriem a povrch uhladíme zahnutou stierkou. Formami jemne poklepeme o pracovnú dosku, aby sa uvoľnili veľké vzduchové bubliny.

7. Pečieme, v polovici formy otočíme, kým korpus nenarastie asi o 2,5 cm, nie je svetlozlatistý a pri jemnom dotyku nepruží, 17 až 20 minút. Formy preložíme na mriežku a korpusy v nich necháme 30 minút chladnúť.

8. Po okrajoch korpusu prejdeme zahnutou stierkou alebo nožom na maslo a korpus opatrne vyklopíme na plech vystlaný papierom na pečenie. Necháme úplne vychladnúť, aspoň 30 minút. (Vychladnutý korpus voľne zabalený vo fólii vydrží pri izbovej teplote až 24 hodín.)
9. Cukrový sirup: v malom hrnci privedieme na strednom ohni cukor s vodou k miernemu varu a za šľahania varíme, kým sa cukor úplne nerozpustí, 5 až 7 minút.

10. Čokoládová ganache: čokoládu, smotanu na šľahanie, kukuričný sirup a soľ dáme do strednej žiaruvzdornej misy. Postavíme ju nad malý hrniec s mierne vriacou vodou a za občasného miešania zohrievame, kým sa čokoláda úplne neroztopí, asi 10 minút. Odstavíme z ohňa a premiešame. Pridáme maslo a jemne vmiešavame, kým ganache nie je hladká a lesklá. Necháme odstáť, kým trochu nevychladne a mierne nezhustne (35 °C), ale je ešte dosť tekutá na liatie, asi 10 minút.

11. Skladanie: krém metličkou vymiešame dohladka. Jeden korpus položíme na tanier. Rovnomerne ho potrieme 1 až 2 PL (15–30 ml) cukrového sirupu. Navrch dáme 475 ml krému a zahnutou stierkou ho rovnomerne roztrieme od okraja po okraj. Položíme druhý korpus a rovnomerne ho potrieme 1 až 2 PL (15–30 ml) cukrového sirupu, aby ho korpus nasal. Mierne zhustnutú ganache nalejeme na tortu a zahnutou stierkou ju rovnomerne roztrieme tak, aby pokryla korpus a prebytok ozdobne stekal po bokoch. Podávame hneď, alebo necháme ganache stuhnúť.

1. To Make the Cakes: Adjust oven racks to upper-middle and lower-middle positions and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.

2. In a large bowl, whisk flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; set aside. In a medium bowl, whisk together milk, oil, egg, butter, and vanilla. Pour wet ingredients into dry and whisk until smooth.

3. Using a 43 g ice cream or portion scoop, scoop out 18 to 20 mounds of batter on prepared sheets. Bake until firm to touch, 8 to 9 minutes, rotating pans from top to bottom and front to back halfway through baking. Transfer parchment sheets (with cakes still attached) to wire rack to cool completely.

4. To Make the Filling: In a small saucepan over medium heat, whisk milk with flour, cocoa powder, and salt until combined. Cook, gently whisking, until mixture thickens and just begins to boil (one to two large bubbles will pop to surface). Cover with plastic wrap and let mixture cool to room temperature.

5. In the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with whip attachment, whip butter, shortening, sugar, and vanilla on medium-high speed until fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add cooked flour mixture and continue to whip until very light and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Reduce speed to low and mix in melted chocolate.

1. Piškóty: rošty v rúre posunieme do hornej a dolnej strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Dva plechy vystelieme papierom na pečenie.

2. Vo veľkej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, cukor, kakao, prášok do pečiva, sódu bikarbónu a soľ; odložíme. V strednej mise metličkou zmiešame mlieko, olej, vajce, maslo a vanilku. Mokré suroviny vlejeme do suchých a vymiešame metličkou dohladka.

3. Naberačkou na zmrzlinu alebo porcovacou naberačkou s objemom 43 g naberieme na pripravené plechy 18 až 20 kôpok cesta. Pečieme, kým nie sú na dotyk pevné, 8 až 9 minút; v polovici pečenia plechy vymeníme zhora nadol a otočíme spredu dozadu. Papiere aj s piškótami preložíme na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť.

4. Plnka: v malom hrnci na strednom ohni metličkou zmiešame mlieko s múkou, kakaom a soľou. Za jemného šľahania varíme, kým zmes nezhustne a práve nezačne vrieť (na povrchu praskne jedna či dve veľké bubliny). Prikryjeme fóliou a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu.

5. V mise kuchynského robota s metlou šľaháme maslo, rastlinný tuk, cukor a vanilku na stredne vysokej rýchlosti do nadýchanej hmoty, asi 2 minúty. Pridáme uvarenú múčnu zmes a šľaháme ďalej, kým nie je veľmi ľahká a nadýchaná, asi 5 minút. Znížime rýchlosť na nízku a vmiešame roztopenú čokoládu.
6. Plnku rozdelíme na polovicu piškót. Prikryjeme zvyšnými piškótami. Podávame.

en.t: Chocolate Brittany shortbread: 90 g flour; 15 g unsweetened cocoa; 70 g unrefined cane sugar; 5 g baking powder; 1 g salt; 80 g butter; 2 egg yolks (40 g)
Chocolate coffee sponge: 60 g ground almonds; 50 g icing sugar; 30 g flour; 25 g cocoa; 3 egg whites (90 g); 30 g sugar; 3 egg yolks (60 g); 20 ml coffee extract; 40 g butter
Passion fruit coffee mousse: 3 gelatine leaves (6 g); 150 g passion fruit purée; 30 ml strong coffee; 40 g sugar; 160 ml whipping cream
Macaroons: 40 ml water; 150 g sugar; 4 egg whites (110 g); 150 g icing sugar; 150 g ground almonds
Glaze: 5 gelatine leaves (10 g); 75 ml water; 150 g sugar; 150 g glucose; 100 g evaporated milk; 150 g white chocolate; yellow food colour; coffee extract
Decoration: sugar flowers; white chocolate heart

1. Shortbread: rub flour, cocoa, cane sugar, baking powder, salt and cold butter to sand; add yolks to a smooth dough; chill briefly. Roll 1 cm thick, set in the 18 cm ring, bake 15–20 minutes at 170 °C (fan 150 °C).

2. Sponge: sift dry ingredients; melt and cool butter. Whisk whites to stiff glossy peaks with the sugar; fold in yolks, coffee extract and butter, then the dry ingredients. Fill a 16 cm ring ¾ full; bake 20–25 minutes at 175 °C (fan 155 °C).
3. Mousse: soften gelatine in cold water and squeeze. Whip cream to stiff peaks. Boil purée, coffee and sugar; off the heat add gelatine; cool to 23 °C; fold in cream.
4. In the 16 cm × 4.5 cm ring layer sponge, mousse, sponge; freeze (2–3 hours).

5. Macaroons: sift dry ingredients. Cook water and sugar to 119 °C, pour slowly into lightly whisked whites and whisk until cold. Fold in dry ingredients until shiny. Pipe 2 cm discs (No. 10 tip) and bake 12–15 minutes at 135 °C (fan 115 °C).
6. Glaze: soften gelatine. Boil water, sugar, glucose and milk; off the heat add chocolate, gelatine, a knife tip of yellow colour and a few drops of coffee extract. Blend and cool to 30 °C.

7. Assembly: set the shortbread on a rack, top with the frozen sponge-mousse, pour over the glaze, smooth, move to a cake slide. Decorate the sides with macaroon shells and the top with sugar flowers and a red-coloured white chocolate heart.

1. Linecké cesto: múku, kakao, trstinový cukor, prášok do pečiva, soľ a studené maslo rozmrvíme na piesok; pridáme žĺtky a spracujeme na hladké cesto; krátko vychladíme. Rozvaľkáme na hrúbku 1 cm, vložíme do 18 cm krúžku a pečieme 15–20 minút pri 170 °C (teplovzdušnú na 150 °C).

4. Do krúžku 16 cm × 4,5 cm navrstvíme piškótu, penu, piškótu; zamrazíme (2–3 hodiny).

5. Makrónky: suché suroviny preosejeme. Vodu s cukrom uvaríme na 119 °C, pomaly vlejeme do zľahka vyšľahaných bielkov a šľaháme do vychladnutia. Vmiešame suché suroviny, kým hmota nie je lesklá. Nastriekame kruhy s priemerom 2 cm (špička č. 10) a pečieme 12–15 minút pri 135 °C (teplovzdušnú na 115 °C).

en.t: 100 g granulated sugar
80 ml water
120 ml tart cherry juice (+ 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) alcohol-free almond extract)
340 g frozen sweet cherries
8 large eggs (≈400 g without shell), room temperature
198 g granulated sugar
226 g bittersweet or semi-sweet chocolate, chopped
43 g Dutch-process cocoa
240 ml boiling water
120 g bleached cake flour
3 g (1 tsp) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
170 g bittersweet or semi-sweet chocolate, chopped
360 ml heavy cream, chilled
2 tbsp (30 ml) instant vanilla pudding mix
25 g (2 tbsp) granulated sugar

1. For the Cherries and Syrup: In a small saucepan, combine sugar and water and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes. Off heat, add cherries and let sit, covered, until thawed and soaked in syrup, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour.

2. Transfer cherries and syrup to a fine-mesh strainer set over a 475 ml measuring cup or bowl. Press fruit with a rubber spatula to release juice. Reserve the 12 prettiest cherries for garnish in a small bowl. Cut remaining cherries in half; set aside.

3. Return reserved syrup to sauce pan. Bring to simmer over medium heat and cook until syrup is thickened and reduced to 120 ml, about 10 minutes. Off heat, stir in 120 ml tart cherry juice and the almond extract (you will have 235 ml syrup).

4. For the Chocolate Genoise: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Lightly grease two 23 cm anodized aluminum cake pans and line with parchment paper (do not grease the parchment). Line two cooling racks with parchment paper.

5. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with whisk attachment, whisk eggs and sugar on medium-high speed until eggs are pale, cream-colored, thick, and voluminous, 10 to 15 minutes. (The egg mixture will rest on top of itself for several seconds when whisk is held about 10 cm above mixture.)
6. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine chocolate and cocoa; pour 235 ml boiling water over mixture and whisk until smooth.

7. Sift flour and salt into chocolate mixture and whisk until thoroughly combined. Whisk in vanilla. Add 240 g of the egg mixture and whisk until mixture is homogeneous. Using a large, flat rubber spatula, gently fold one-third of remaining egg mixture into batter until mostly incorporated. Repeat with one-third more egg mixture. Add remaining third of egg mixture and continue folding, taking care to scrape bottom of bowl, until no streaks remain.
8. Divide the batter into prepared pans. Firmly tap pan on counter to remove large air bubbles.

9. Bake until cake is puffed and pulling away from the sides slightly, 25 to 30 minutes (the cake should also bounce slightly when tapped with a finger). Do not open the oven for at least 20 minutes, or you risk the cake collapsing. Once cake is removed from the oven, lift the pan about 20 cm above the work surface and drop it; this helps prevent the cake from shrinking.

10. Immediately run a small offset spatula around the sides of cake pan to loosen. Invert cake onto prepared wire racks, remove parchment from bottom of cake (a thin layer of the cake will rip off with the parchment; this is OK), and let cool completely, about 1 hour.

11. For the Chocolate Bark: Meanwhile, line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Microwave chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl at 50% power, stirring occasionally, until melted and combined, about 2 minutes. Using a large offset spatula, spread the melted chocolate in a thin layer across the prepared sheet, covering the entire piece of parchment. Refrigerate until matte and firm, 30 to 40 minutes.

12. For the Whipped Cream: When cake is completely cooled, and you are ready to assemble, using a stand mixer fitted with a whisk attachment, whip cream on medium-low speed until foamy, about 1 minute. With mixer running, add pudding mix and sugar. Increase speed to medium-high and whip until just-stiff peaks form, 1 to 3 minutes (do not overbeat). Transfer 235 ml of whipped cream to a pastry bag fitted with a 1.5 cm open or closed star tip and set aside.
13. To Assemble the Cake: Line edges of cake platter with 4 strips of parchment paper to keep platter clean. Brush the top of each layer with 4 tbsp (59 ml) of reserved syrup.

14. Place 1 cake layer on a platter, syrup-side down. Remove the parchment (if it doesn't lift a thin layer of cake, use a serrated knife to lightly trim enough to expose the spongy cake; this will help the syrup absorb). Brush with 4 tbsp (59 ml) of syrup. Using an offset spatula, spread 120 ml cream evenly over bottom cake layer. Arrange all of the halved cherries on cream. Dollop 235 ml cream over the cherries and spread evenly. Top it with the second cake layer, syrup-side down. Remove parchment (repeating trimming if necessary) and brush with remaining 4 tbsp (59 ml) of syrup.
15. Spread remaining whipped cream evenly over top and sides of cake. Pipe a decorative border around the top edge of the cake. Arrange reserved whole cherries decoratively on top of cake.

16. Carefully remove parchment strips from platter and wipe platter clean. Break the chocolate bark into 4–5 cm pieces, then, starting from the top, gently shingle the pieces along the sides of the cake. Refrigerate the cake to allow it to absorb the syrup for at least 4 hours or up to 24 hours.
17. Before slicing and serving, let cake sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Dip a sharp chef's knife in very hot water and wipe dry between cuts. Serve.

1. Čerešne a sirup: v malom hrnci spojíme cukor s vodou a na stredne silnom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu. Za občasného miešania varíme, kým sa cukor nerozpustí, asi 2 minúty. Mimo ohňa pridáme čerešne a necháme ich prikryté postáť, kým sa nerozmrazia a nenasiaknu sirupom, za občasného miešania, asi 1 hodinu.

2. Čerešne so sirupom preložíme do jemného sitka nad 475 ml odmerkou alebo misou. Ovocie pritlačíme gumenou stierkou, aby pustilo šťavu. 12 najkrajších čerešní si odložíme na ozdobu do malej misky. Zvyšné čerešne prekrojíme na polovice; odložíme.

3. Odložený sirup vrátime do hrnca. Na strednom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu a varíme, kým sirup nezhustne a nezredukuje sa na 120 ml, asi 10 minút. Mimo ohňa vmiešame 120 ml šťavy z kyslých višní a mandľový extrakt (budeme mať 235 ml sirupu).

4. Čokoládová piškóta: rošt v rúre posunieme do stredu a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Dve tortové formy z eloxovaného hliníka s priemerom 23 cm zľahka vymastíme a vystelieme papierom na pečenie (papier nemastíme). Dve mriežky vystelieme papierom na pečenie.

5. V mise kuchynského robota s metlou šľaháme vajcia s cukrom na stredne vysokej rýchlosti, kým nie sú svetlé, krémovej farby, husté a objemné, 10 až 15 minút. (Keď metlu zdvihneme asi 10 cm nad zmes, stekajúca zmes zostane niekoľko sekúnd ležať na povrchu.)
6. Medzitým vo veľkej mise spojíme čokoládu a kakao; zalejeme 235 ml vriacej vody a vymiešame metličkou dohladka.

7. Do čokoládovej zmesi preosejeme múku so soľou a metličkou dôkladne premiešame. Zašľaháme vanilku. Pridáme 240 g vaječnej zmesi a šľaháme, kým zmes nie je jednoliata. Veľkou plochou gumenou stierkou jemne vmiešame tretinu zvyšnej vaječnej zmesi, kým sa väčšinou nezapracuje. Zopakujeme s ďalšou tretinou. Pridáme poslednú tretinu vaječnej zmesi a vmiešavame ďalej, pričom zotierame dno misy, kým nezmiznú šmuhy.
8. Cesto rozdelíme do pripravených foriem. Formou pevne poklepeme o pracovnú dosku, aby sa uvoľnili veľké vzduchové bubliny.

9. Pečieme, kým nie je piškóta nadýchaná a mierne sa neodťahuje od stien, 25 až 30 minút (piškóta pri poklepaní prstom aj mierne pruží). Rúru neotvárame aspoň 20 minút, inak hrozí, že piškóta spľasne. Po vybratí z rúry formu zdvihneme asi 20 cm nad pracovnú dosku a pustíme ju; pomôže to, aby sa piškóta nezmršťovala.

10. Hneď prejdeme malou zahnutou stierkou po stenách formy, aby sa piškóta uvoľnila. Vyklopíme ju na pripravené mriežky, zo spodku stiahneme papier (tenká vrstva piškóty sa odtrhne spolu s papierom; to nevadí) a necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 1 hodinu.

11. Čokoládové hobliny: medzitým plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Čokoládu v mise vhodnej do mikrovlnnej rúry roztápame na 50 % výkonu za občasného miešania, kým sa neroztopí a nespojí, asi 2 minúty. Veľkou zahnutou stierkou roztopenú čokoládu roztrieme v tenkej vrstve po celom papieri na plechu. Necháme v chladničke, kým nie je matná a pevná, 30 až 40 minút.

12. Šľahačka: keď je piškóta úplne vychladnutá a sme pripravení skladať, v kuchynskom robote s metlou šľaháme smotanu na stredne nízkej rýchlosti do peny, asi 1 minútu. Za chodu robota pridáme pudingový prášok a cukor. Zvýšime na stredne vysokú rýchlosť a šľaháme, len kým nevzniknú práve pevné špičky, 1 až 3 minúty (neprešľaháme). 235 ml šľahačky preložíme do cukrárskeho vrecka s otvorenou alebo uzavretou hviezdicovou špičkou 1,5 cm a odložíme.
13. Skladanie torty: okraje tortového taniera obložíme 4 pásikmi papiera na pečenie, aby zostal čistý. Vrch každého plátu potrieme 4 PL (59 ml) odloženého sirupu.

14. Jeden plát položíme na tanier stranou so sirupom nadol. Stiahneme papier (ak neodtrhne tenkú vrstvu piškóty, zúbkovaným nožom zľahka odrežeme toľko, aby sa odkryla hubovitá piškóta; lepšie nasaje sirup). Potrieme 4 PL (59 ml) sirupu. Zahnutou stierkou rovnomerne roztrieme na spodný plát 120 ml šľahačky. Na šľahačku rozložíme všetky prekrojené čerešne. Navrch dáme 235 ml šľahačky a rovnomerne roztrieme. Položíme druhý plát stranou so sirupom nadol. Stiahneme papier (ak treba, opäť zarovnáme) a potrieme zvyšnými 4 PL (59 ml) sirupu.
15. Zvyšnou šľahačkou rovnomerne potrieme vrch a boky torty. Po hornom okraji torty nastriekame ozdobný lem. Navrch ozdobne rozložíme odložené celé čerešne.

16. Opatrne odstránime pásiky papiera z taniera a tanier utrieme. Čokoládovú platňu polámeme na kúsky 4–5 cm a odhora ich jemne prekrývavo prikladáme na boky torty. Tortu necháme v chladničke aspoň 4 a najviac 24 hodín, aby nasiakla sirupom.
17. Pred krájaním a podávaním necháme tortu 30 minút až 1 hodinu pri izbovej teplote. Ostrý kuchársky nôž namáčame do veľmi horúcej vody a medzi rezmi ho utrieme dosucha. Podávame.

Tamina verzia: bez kirschu; použite variant so šťavou z višní a nealkoholickým mandľovým extraktom.

src: King Arthur Baking (MaryJane Robbins), "Sacher Torte"

en.t: 170 g bittersweet chocolate wafers
8 large eggs (≈400 g without shell), separated, at room temperature
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, melted
1 tsp (5 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/8 tsp (0.8 g) table salt
149 g King Arthur Baker's Special Sugar*
120 g King Arthur Unbleached Cake Flour
113 g apricot jam
170 g bittersweet chocolate wafers
113 g water, boiling
198 g granulated sugar

1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Spray one 23 cm by 5 cm round cake pan with cooking spray and line with parchment. Spritz the parchment lightly as well. If your pan isn't at least 5 cm deep, use two pans instead of one.
2. To make the cake: Over low heat or in the microwave melt the chocolate slowly, stirring well.
3. In a small bowl, lightly beat the 8 egg yolks. Add the melted chocolate, melted butter, and vanilla. Blend until smooth and satiny, with no lumps or unincorporated yolks.

4. In the bowl of a stand mixer, beat the 8 egg whites with a pinch of salt until they begin to foam. Slowly add the sugar, then beat on high speed until the whites hold a stiff peak but are still glossy.

5. Using a wide rubber spatula, mix about 1/3 of the egg whites into the chocolate/yolk mixture to lighten it. Now, pour the lightened chocolate mixture over the rest of the whites in the bowl. Fold gently, using about 20 to 30 strokes.
6. Sprinkle the cake flour over the chocolate batter and continue to fold gently until there are no traces of egg white remaining.

7. Pour the batter into the pan(s). Bake until the cake is puffed and dry looking on top, and a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean: 40 to 45 minutes for a single pan, 20 to 25 minutes for two pans. Remove from the oven and cool in the pan(s) for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack to cool completely. Be sure to peel off the parchment circle while the cake is still warm.
8. While the cake is cooling, strain the apricot jam through a fine sieve to remove any bits of fruit and make a smooth filling.

9. To fill the cake: If you used one cake pan, you will need to split the layer before filling. Use a long, sharp serrated knife to split the cake into two even layers. If you used two pans, simply spread the apricot jam between the layers, leaving 1.5 cm around the border so that the jam does not squeeze out over the sides of the cake.

10. To make the chocolate glaze: Place the filled cake on a wire rack over a parchment lined baking sheet. Place the chocolate, water and sugar in a medium-sized saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring frequently until the glaze is smooth, shiny and slightly thickened, about 4 to 5 minutes.

11. As soon as the glaze is smooth, immediately pour over the cake. The excess glaze will drip off of the cake onto the parchment paper. You can scoop up the excess glaze to cover any bare spots on the cake. Use a flexible spatula to help spread the glaze on the top and sides of the cake, but do not overwork the glaze or it will not remain smooth and sleek.
12. Allow the glaze to set up at room temperature for a few hours before serving. This cake is best served the day it's made. Store any leftovers at room temperature for 1 day.

9. To fill the cake: If you used one cake pan, you will need to split the layer before filling. Use a long, sharp serrated knife to split the cake into two even layers. If you used two pans, simply spread the apricot jam between the layers, leaving 1.5 cm around the border so that the jam does not squeeze out over the sides of the cake.

10. To make the chocolate glaze: Place the filled cake on a wire rack over a parchment lined baking sheet. Place the chocolate, water and sugar in a medium-sized saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring frequently until the glaze is smooth, shiny and slightly thickened, about 4 to 5 minutes.

11. As soon as the glaze is smooth, immediately pour over the cake. The excess glaze will drip off of the cake onto the parchment paper. You can scoop up the excess glaze to cover any bare spots on the cake. Use a flexible spatula to help spread the glaze on the top and sides of the cake, but do not overwork the glaze or it will not remain smooth and sleek.
12. Allow the glaze to set up at room temperature for a few hours before serving. This cake is best served the day it's made. Store any leftovers at room temperature for 1 day.

1. Rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Jednu okrúhlu tortovú formu 23 cm × 5 cm postriekame olejom v spreji a vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Aj papier zľahka postriekame. Ak forma nie je hlboká aspoň 5 cm, použijeme namiesto jednej dve formy.
2. Cesto: na miernom ohni alebo v mikrovlnnej rúre pomaly roztopíme čokoládu a dobre premiešame.
3. V malej mise zľahka rozšľaháme 8 žĺtkov. Pridáme roztopenú čokoládu, rozpustené maslo a vanilku. Vymiešame do hladkej a saténovej hmoty bez hrudiek a nezapracovaných žĺtkov.
4. V mise kuchynského robota šľaháme 8 bielkov so štipkou soli, kým nezačnú peniť. Pomaly pridávame cukor, potom šľaháme na vysokej rýchlosti, kým bielky nedržia pevnú špičku, ale sú ešte lesklé.
5. Širokou gumenou stierkou vmiešame asi 1/3 snehu do čokoládovo-žĺtkovej zmesi, aby ju odľahčila. Odľahčenú čokoládovú zmes potom vlejeme na zvyšný sneh v mise. Jemne vmiešame asi 20 až 30 pohybmi.
6. Na čokoládové cesto posypeme hladkú múku na pečivo a jemne vmiešavame ďalej, kým nezmiznú všetky stopy snehu.

7. Cesto nalejeme do formy (foriem). Pečieme, kým nie je korpus nadýchaný a navrchu suchý a skúšobná ihla zapichnutá do stredu nevyjde čistá: 40 až 45 minút v jednej forme, 20 až 25 minút v dvoch formách. Vyberieme z rúry a necháme 10 minút chladnúť vo forme (formách), potom vyklopíme na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť. Kruh papiera stiahneme, kým je korpus ešte teplý.
8. Kým korpus chladne, marhuľový džem pretrieme cez jemné sitko, aby sme odstránili kúsky ovocia a získali hladkú plnku.

9. Plnenie torty: ak sme piekli v jednej forme, plát pred plnením prerežeme. Dlhým ostrým zúbkovaným nožom ho rozrežeme na dva rovnaké pláty. Ak sme použili dve formy, jednoducho medzi pláty natrieme marhuľový džem a po okraji necháme 1,5 cm voľných, aby džem nevytekal po bokoch torty.

10. Čokoládová poleva: naplnenú tortu položíme na mriežku nad plechom vystlaným papierom na pečenie. Čokoládu, vodu a cukor dáme do stredného hrnca na stredne mierny oheň. Za častého miešania varíme, kým poleva nie je hladká, lesklá a mierne zhustnutá, asi 4 až 5 minút.

11. Hneď ako je poleva hladká, nalejeme ju na tortu. Prebytočná poleva steká z torty na papier. Stečenú polevu môžeme nabrať a zakryť ňou prípadné holé miesta. Ohybnou stierkou si pomôžeme rozotrieť polevu po vrchu a bokoch torty, no polevu príliš neprepracúvame, inak nezostane hladká a lesklá.
12. Pred podávaním necháme polevu niekoľko hodín stuhnúť pri izbovej teplote. Torta je najlepšia v deň prípravy. Zvyšky uchovávame pri izbovej teplote 1 deň.

1. To make the chocolate ganache: Place the chocolate in a bowl. Heat the cream in a saucepan or in the microwave, until the mixture begins to steam. Pour over the chocolate, let sit for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir until the chocolate is completely melted. Set aside to cool to room temperature. While the mixture is cooling, make the cake.
2. To make the cake: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Line a baking sheet (half-sheet pan) with parchment and grease the paper with nonstick spray.
3. In a large bowl, whip the egg whites to soft peaks. Gradually add 66 g of the sugar, and continue beating the whites until medium peaks form. Set the whites aside.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients, including the remaining 133 g of the sugar. Set aside.

5. In the bowl of a stand mixer, mix the reserved egg yolks, oil, milk, and vanilla until blended. Beat on medium speed until lightened and pale lemon colored. Add the dry ingredients and continue to mix until smooth, about 1 minute.
6. Remove the bowl from the mixer. Using a large flexible spatula or whisk, gently fold the egg whites into the batter, one-third at a time. Use gentle motions to preserve the air in the whites.
7. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and spread evenly with a spatula. Bake the cake for 10 to 14 minutes or until it's set in the middle and springs back when pressed gently.

8. Remove the cake from the oven, let it cool in the pan for 1 to 2 minutes, then loosen the edges with a knife. Turn the cake out onto a kitchen towel lightly dusted with confectioners’ sugar and peel off the parchment. Allow the cake to rest for 1 to 2 minutes, then roll it up loosely in the towel (starting with a short end) and let it cool completely.

9. To finish the filling: Once the ganache has cooled to room temperature, transfer it to a mixing bowl and add the salt and vanilla. Using an electric hand mixer or a stand mixer with the whisk attachment, whip the ganache on low speed and slowly add the butter in three additions. Once all the butter has been added increase the speed and whip until fluffy, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.

10. To assemble the Bûche de Noël: Unroll the cooled cake and spread it with approximately 85 g of the filling. Re-roll, and place seam-side down on a serving plate. Use the remaining filling to frost the outside of the roll. If desired, dust with confectioners’ sugar and decorate with candied cranberries or meringue mushrooms.

11. Serving and storage information: Serve the Bûche de Noël immediately, or refrigerate until ready to serve, up to 24 hours. Freeze for longer storage. If refrigerated or frozen, let the cake come to room temperature before serving.

1. Čokoládová ganache: čokoládu dáme do misy. Smotanu zohrejeme v hrnci alebo mikrovlnnej rúre, kým nezačne pariť. Nalejeme ju na čokoládu, necháme 2 až 3 minúty postáť a potom miešame, kým sa čokoláda úplne neroztopí. Necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu. Kým zmes chladne, pripravíme piškótu.
2. Piškóta: rúru predhrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Plech (polovičný plech) vystelieme papierom na pečenie a papier postriekame nepriľnavým sprejom.
3. Vo veľkej mise vyšľaháme bielky do mäkkých špičiek. Postupne pridávame 50 g cukru a šľaháme ďalej, kým nevzniknú stredne pevné špičky. Sneh odložíme.
4. V malej mise metličkou zmiešame suché suroviny vrátane zvyšných 100 g cukru. Odložíme.

5. V mise kuchynského robota zmiešame odložené žĺtky, olej, mlieko a vanilku. Šľaháme na strednej rýchlosti, kým zmes nezosvetlie a nemá svetlú citrónovú farbu. Pridáme suché suroviny a miešame dohladka, asi 1 minútu.
6. Misu vyberieme z robota. Veľkou ohybnou stierkou alebo metličkou jemne vmiešame sneh do cesta po tretinách. Miešame jemnými pohybmi, aby sme zachovali vzduch v bielkoch.
7. Cesto nalejeme do pripraveného plechu a rovnomerne roztrieme stierkou. Piškótu pečieme 10 až 14 minút, kým nie je v strede stuhnutá a pri jemnom stlačení nepruží.

8. Piškótu vyberieme z rúry, necháme ju 1 až 2 minúty chladnúť v plechu a potom nožom uvoľníme okraje. Vyklopíme ju na kuchynskú utierku zľahka poprášenú práškovým cukrom a stiahneme papier. Necháme 1 až 2 minúty odpočívať, potom ju aj s utierkou voľne zrolujeme (od kratšej strany) a necháme úplne vychladnúť.

9. Dokončenie plnky: keď ganache vychladne na izbovú teplotu, preložíme ju do misy a pridáme soľ a vanilku. Ručným elektrickým šľahačom alebo kuchynským robotom s metlou šľaháme ganache na nízkej rýchlosti a pomaly pridávame maslo na tri razy. c.t: Black cherry jam is traditional in the Basque Country, but any cherry jam or preserves work. 225 g chocolate pastry cream can replace the vanilla pastry cream.
V Baskicku sa tradične používa džem z čiernych čerešní, ale poslúži akýkoľvek čerešňový džem či lekvár. Vanilkový krém môžete nahradiť 225 g čokoládového.

en.t: 250 g all-purpose flour
50 g almond flour
1 tsp (4 g) baking powder
3/4 tsp (2 g) plus 1/8 tsp (0.4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt, divided; for table salt, use half as much by volume
210 g unsalted butter (15 tbsp), softened to about 18 °C, plus more for greasing
150 g granulated sugar
1 large egg (50 g), brought to slightly cooler than room temperature, plus 1 large egg and 1 large egg yolk (15 g), straight from the fridge, for egg wash
225 g vanilla pastry cream
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) pure almond extract
1 tbsp (15 ml) heavy cream
85 g black or other cherry jam, spread, or preserves
1. In a medium bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, almond flour, baking powder, and 3/4 tsp (3 g) salt until thoroughly combined. Set aside.

2. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine butter and sugar and mix on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape down bowl and paddle, add the 1 large egg, and mix on medium speed until fully incorporated, about 1 minute. Scrape down bowl and paddle, add half of flour mixture, then mix on low speed until just combined, about 15 seconds. Repeat with remaining flour mixture, scraping down bowl and paddle as needed.

3. Scrape dough, along with any loose bits, onto a lightly floured work surface and, using your hands, bring dough together into a smooth ball (dough should be soft and slightly sticky but refrain from adding more flour). Divide dough into 2 equal portions (about 340 g each) and shape into flat, round disks. Wrap each disk tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours and up to 1 day.
4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Grease a 20 cm cake pan with butter and set aside. Remove dough disks from refrigerator and set on clean work surface.
5. In a medium bowl, whisk together pastry cream and almond extract until thoroughly combined. Set aside.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining whole egg and egg yolk with the cream and the remaining 1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) salt until homogeneous. Set egg wash aside.

7. Place one dough disk on a lightly floured work surface. Using a rolling pin and adding flour as needed underneath and on top of the dough to prevent sticking, roll out to a 23 cm circle that’s about 0.5 cm thick. Transfer to the prepared cake pan by carefully rolling dough around the rolling pin, then unrolling over the pan. Press dough gently yet firmly into the corners and up the sides of the pan. Dust off excess flour with a pastry brush.

8. Add cherry jam to the center of the dough, and using the back of a spoon or a small offset spatula, spread in a smooth, even layer, leaving 1.5 cm of space around the perimeter. Repeat with prepared pastry cream, spreading evenly on top of jam.

9. Place second dough disk on a lightly floured work surface. Using a rolling pin and adding flour as needed underneath and on top of the dough to prevent sticking, roll out to a 22 cm circle that’s about 0.5 cm thick. Transfer to the cake pan by carefully rolling dough around the rolling pin, then unrolling over the filling. Using your hands, tuck the top layer of dough in along the space around the perimeter, making sure that the outermost edge of the dough is upright. Using your thumbs, seal the top and bottom edges of dough together. Fold the excess dough up and back over the top, pressing down around the perimeter to smooth out the dough. Dust off excess flour with a pastry brush.

10. Using a pastry brush, brush top surface all over with egg wash. Using the tines of a fork, gently scrape a decorative pattern onto the surface (a crosshatch pattern is traditional but you can be as creative as you like).
11. Bake cake until puffed and deep golden brown, about 45 minutes.

12. Transfer cake pan to a wire rack and let cool completely to room temperature, about 2 hours. Run a butter knife along edges to loosen, then invert onto wire rack, remove pan, and place cake right side up on a serving platter. Slice and serve.

1 veľké vajce (50 g), o niečo chladnejšie ako izbová teplota, a 1 veľké vajce a 1 veľký žĺtok (15 g) priamo z chladničky na potretie

c.t: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, almond flour, baking powder, and 3/4 tsp (3 g) salt until thoroughly combined. Set aside.

2. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine butter and sugar and mix on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape down bowl and paddle, add the 1 large egg, and mix on medium speed until fully incorporated, about 1 minute. Scrape down bowl and paddle, add half of flour mixture, then mix on low speed until just combined, about 15 seconds. Repeat with remaining flour mixture, scraping down bowl and paddle as needed.

3. Scrape dough, along with any loose bits, onto a lightly floured work surface and, using your hands, bring dough together into a smooth ball (dough should be soft and slightly sticky but refrain from adding more flour). Divide dough into 2 equal portions (about 340 g each) and shape into flat, round disks. Wrap each disk tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours and up to 1 day.
4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Grease a 20 cm cake pan with butter and set aside. Remove dough disks from refrigerator and set on clean work surface.
5. In a medium bowl, whisk together pastry cream and almond extract until thoroughly combined. Set aside.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining whole egg and egg yolk with the cream and the remaining 1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) salt until homogeneous. Set egg wash aside.

7. Place one dough disk on a lightly floured work surface. Using a rolling pin and adding flour as needed underneath and on top of the dough to prevent sticking, roll out to a 23 cm circle that’s about 0.5 cm thick. Transfer to the prepared cake pan by carefully rolling dough around the rolling pin, then unrolling over the pan. Press dough gently yet firmly into the corners and up the sides of the pan. Dust off excess flour with a pastry brush.

8. Add cherry jam to the center of the dough, and using the back of a spoon or a small offset spatula, spread in a smooth, even layer, leaving 1.5 cm of space around the perimeter. Repeat with prepared pastry cream, spreading evenly on top of jam.

9. Place second dough disk on a lightly floured work surface. Using a rolling pin and adding flour as needed underneath and on top of the dough to prevent sticking, roll out to a 22 cm circle that’s about 0.5 cm thick. Transfer to the cake pan by carefully rolling dough around the rolling pin, then unrolling over the filling. Using your hands, tuck the top layer of dough in along the space around the perimeter, making sure that the outermost edge of the dough is upright. Using your thumbs, seal the top and bottom edges of dough together. Fold the excess dough up and back over the top, pressing down around the perimeter to smooth out the dough. Dust off excess flour with a pastry brush.

10. Using a pastry brush, brush top surface all over with egg wash. Using the tines of a fork, gently scrape a decorative pattern onto the surface (a crosshatch pattern is traditional but you can be as creative as you like).
11. Bake cake until puffed and deep golden brown, about 45 minutes.

12. Transfer cake pan to a wire rack and let cool completely to room temperature, about 2 hours. Run a butter knife along edges to loosen, then invert onto wire rack, remove pan, and place cake right side up on a serving platter. Slice and serve.
1. V strednej mise metličkou dôkladne zmiešame hladkú múku, mandľovú múku, prášok do pečiva a 3/4 ČL (3 g) soli. Odložíme.

2. V mise kuchynského robota s plochým miešadlom spojíme maslo s cukrom a šľaháme na strednej rýchlosti do ľahkej a nadýchanej hmoty, asi 3 minúty. Zotrieme misu aj miešadlo, pridáme 1 veľké vajce a šľaháme na strednej rýchlosti, kým sa úplne nezapracuje, asi 1 minútu. Zotrieme misu aj miešadlo, pridáme polovicu múčnej zmesi a miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, len kým sa nespojí, asi 15 sekúnd. Zopakujeme so zvyšnou múčnou zmesou; podľa potreby zotierame misu aj miešadlo.

3. Cesto aj so všetkými voľnými kúskami zotrieme na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú plochu a rukami ho spojíme do hladkej gule (cesto má byť mäkké a mierne lepkavé, ale múku už nepridávame). Rozdelíme ho na 2 rovnaké diely (asi po 340 g) a vytvarujeme ploché okrúhle disky. Každý disk pevne zabalíme do fólie a necháme v chladničke aspoň 3 hodiny a najviac 1 deň.

4. Rošt v rúre posunieme do stredu a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Tortovú formu s priemerom 20 cm vymastíme maslom a odložíme. Disky cesta vyberieme z chladničky a položíme na čistú pracovnú plochu.
5. V strednej mise metličkou dôkladne zmiešame krém s mandľovým extraktom. Odložíme.
6. V malej mise metličkou vymiešame zvyšné celé vajce a žĺtok so smotanou a zvyšnou 1/8 ČL (0,6 ml) soli, kým nie je zmes jednoliata. Vajíčko na potieranie odložíme.

7. Jeden disk cesta položíme na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú plochu. Valčekom ho rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 23 cm a hrúbkou asi 0,5 cm; podľa potreby podsypávame múku pod cesto aj naň, aby sa nelepilo. Cesto opatrne navinieme na valček, rozvinieme nad pripravenou formou a preložíme doň. Cesto jemne, ale pevne vtlačíme do rohov a na steny formy. Prebytočnú múku zmetieme cukrárskym štetcom.

8. Do stredu cesta dáme čerešňový džem a zadnou stranou lyžice alebo malou zahnutou stierkou ho roztrieme do hladkej rovnomernej vrstvy; po obvode necháme 1,5 cm voľných. Rovnako rovnomerne roztrieme na džem pripravený krém.

9. Druhý disk cesta položíme na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú plochu. Valčekom ho rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 22 cm a hrúbkou asi 0,5 cm; podľa potreby podsypávame múku pod cesto aj naň, aby sa nelepilo. Cesto opatrne navinieme na valček a rozvinieme nad plnkou vo forme. Rukami zastrčíme vrchnú vrstvu cesta do voľného priestoru po obvode tak, aby vonkajší okraj cesta stál zvisle. Palcami spojíme horný a spodný okraj cesta. Prebytočné cesto preložíme nahor a dozadu cez vrch a po obvode ho pritlačíme, aby sa cesto vyhladilo. Prebytočnú múku zmetieme cukrárskym štetcom.
10. Cukrárskym štetcom potrieme celý povrch vajíčkom. Hrotmi vidličky jemne vyryjeme na povrch ozdobný vzor (tradičná je mriežka, ale môžeme byť kreatívni, ako chceme).
11. Koláč pečieme, kým nie je nadýchaný a sýto zlatohnedý, asi 45 minút.

12. Formu preložíme na mriežku a koláč necháme úplne vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, asi 2 hodiny. Po okrajoch prejdeme nožom na maslo, aby sa uvoľnil, potom ho vyklopíme na mriežku, odstránime formu a koláč položíme správnou stranou nahor na servírovací tanier. Nakrájame a podávame.

en.t: 240 g all-purpose flour
4 tsp (16 g) baking powder
6 large eggs (≈300 g without shell), separated
1 tsp (6 g) salt
395 g sugar
120 ml milk
2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract
2 (340 g) cans evaporated milk
2 (395 g) cans sweetened condensed milk
710 ml heavy cream
1 tsp (3 g) unflavored gelatin
2 tbsp (30 ml) water
57 g cream cheese, softened
56 g confectioners’ sugar
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 160 °C (fan 140 °C).
2. Combine flour and baking powder in a small bowl; set aside.

3. In the bowl of a stand mixer, beat egg whites and salt with whisk attachment on medium-low speed until whites begin to froth, about 1 minute. Increase speed to medium-high and beat whites until soft peaks form, 1 to 2 minutes. Slowly add the sugar and continue beating until stiff peaks form, 2 to 3 minutes. The mixture may look a bit thick.

4. Add egg yolks and beat just until combined. Decrease speed to low and add flour in 3 additions, alternating with the milk, scraping sides and bottom of bowl as necessary. Add vanilla and beat just until combined.

5. Scrape batter into an ungreased 33 × 23 cm baking dish. Bake until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes. Transfer cake to cooling rack and cool completely in pan, 60 to 90 minutes.

6. Once cooled, poke cake all over with fork. Combine evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, and 355 ml heavy cream in large bowl. Pour mixture evenly all over cake. While cake soaks, make whipped cream.
7. Combine gelatin and water in a small bowl. Microwave until gelatin dissolves, about 20 seconds. Cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes.

8. In the clean bowl of stand mixer, beat cream cheese, confectioners’ sugar, and cooled gelatin with whisk attachment until soft and whippy, about 2 minutes. Add remaining 355 ml cream and beat to soft peaks, about 2 minutes.
9. Spread whipped cream over cake and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 2 hours. Serve.

Zvýšime na stredne vysokú rýchlosť a šľaháme do mäkkých špičiek, 1 až 2 minúty. Pomaly pridávame cukor a šľaháme ďalej do pevných špičiek, 2 až 3 minúty. Zmes môže vyzerať trochu hustá.

4. Pridáme žĺtky a šľaháme, len kým sa nespoja. Znížime rýchlosť na nízku a pridáme múku na 3 razy striedavo s mliekom; podľa potreby zotierame steny a dno misy. Pridáme vanilku a šľaháme, len kým sa nespojí.

5. Cesto zotrieme do nevymastenej zapekacej misy 33 × 23 cm. Pečieme, kým skúšobná ihla zapichnutá do stredu nevyjde čistá, 30 až 35 minút. Koláč preložíme na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť vo forme, 60 až 90 minút.

6. Vychladnutý koláč celý popicháme vidličkou. Vo veľkej mise zmiešame zahustené mlieko, sladené kondenzované mlieko a 355 ml smotany na šľahanie. Zmesou rovnomerne prelejeme celý koláč. Kým koláč nasiakne, pripravíme šľahačku.
7. V malej miske spojíme želatínu s vodou. Ohrievame v mikrovlnnej rúre, kým sa želatína nerozpustí, asi 20 sekúnd. Necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, asi 5 minút.

8. V čistej mise kuchynského robota šľaháme metlou krémový syr, práškový cukor a vychladnutú želatínu, kým zmes nie je mäkká a nadýchaná, asi 2 minúty. Pridáme zvyšných 355 ml smotany a šľaháme do mäkkých špičiek, asi 2 minúty.
9. Šľahačku roztrieme na koláč a necháme v chladničke dôkladne vychladiť, aspoň 2 hodiny. Podávame.

cat.en: The gelatin and cream cheese stabilise the whipped cream; omit them if the cake will be eaten in one sitting. Chill the cake thoroughly before serving (20 to 30 minutes in the freezer helps).

tip.en: Use Dutch-processed cocoa: it is higher in fat and more aromatic than natural cocoa, giving a more flavourful chocolate cake.

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 200 °C (fan 180 °C).

2. Melt chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl set over a pan of simmering water (make sure the water doesn’t touch the bottom of the bowl); alternatively, melt chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl in the microwave, stirring after every 20-second interval. Once fully melted, whisk in powdered sugar (it's okay if it looks a little bit lumpy).
3. Separate the egg into two small bowls. Whisk the egg white briefly with a fork, then add half the egg white to the yolk. Discard the remaining half of the egg white.
4. Add the yolk and half the egg white to the chocolate mixture and whisk until incorporated. Add flour and salt and whisk until the batter is smooth.
5. Pour the batter into a 120 ml ramekin. Bake until the cake is set around the edges but still molten within, about 12 minutes. Let cool for 1 minute before adding toppings. Serve immediately.

en.t: 300 g shredded sweetened coconut
227 g pecan halves
1 (395 g) can unsweetened full-fat coconut milk
319 g light brown sugar
3 g (1 tsp) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half by volume or the same weight
5 large egg yolks (≈90 g)
170 g unsalted butter (12 tbsp), cut into 1.5 cm pieces
1 tbsp (15 ml) vanilla extract
113 g Baker's German's Sweet Chocolate brand, chopped
120 ml boiling water
256 g all-purpose flour
21 g natural cocoa
1 tsp (6 g) baking soda
3 g (1 tsp) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
240 ml buttermilk
2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract
170 g unsalted butter (12 tbsp), at room temperature and cut into 6 pieces, plus 1 to 2 tbsp (14–28 g) softened butter for greasing cake pans
198 g granulated sugar
107 g light brown sugar
4 large eggs (≈200 g without shell)

1. For The Coconut-Pecan Frosting: Adjust oven rack to middle and lower-middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Spread coconut evenly on a rimmed sheet pan and pecans on a second rimmed sheet pan. Place coconut on middle rack and pecans on lower-middle rack and bake, stirring often, until coconut is evenly golden and pecans are fragrant and browned, 12 to 15 minutes. Let pans cool on wire racks until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes. Reserve 56 g halved pecans separately to decorate top of cake later. Chop remaining 170 g pecans; set aside.

2. In a medium saucepan, whisk coconut milk, brown sugar, and salt until well combined. Add yolks and whisk until combined. Add butter and cook over medium-high heat, whisking and scraping sides and bottom constantly, until mixture vigorously simmers and slightly thickens, about 6 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl, then stir in vanilla and cooled, toasted coconut. Let mixture cool to room temperature while baking cakes.

3. For the Chocolate Cake: Meanwhile, grease two 23 cm anodized aluminum round cake pans with butter and line with parchment paper. Combine the chocolate and boiling water in a small bowl, then whisk until the chocolate is melted and smooth. Let cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes.
4. In a medium bowl, sift flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt, and whisk to combine; set aside. Combine buttermilk and vanilla in a liquid measuring cup; set aside.
5. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat butter, sugar, and brown sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, 4 to 7 minutes, scraping down the sides as necessary.
6. While the mixer is running, add eggs, one at a time, letting each fully incorporate before adding the next and scraping down the sides as necessary.
7. While the mixer is running, add chocolate mixture and beat to combine, about 1 minute, scraping down sides and bottom of bowl with rubber spatula as needed.

8. Reduce speed to low. Starting and ending with dry ingredients, add 1/3 of the flour mixture, then alternate with 1/2 of the buttermilk mixture, and repeat until all is incorporated, scraping down the sides and bottom of the bowl as needed with a rubber spatula, until combined.

9. Divide batter evenly between prepared pans and smooth cake tops with small offset spatula. Bake cakes at same time on same rack until the cakes are just firm and a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, 25 to 30 minutes.

10. Let cakes cool in pans for 15 minutes, then run a butter knife or offset spatula around the edges to loosen. Remove cakes from pans (do not remove parchment) and return cakes right-side-up. Let cool completely on a wire rack, about 1 hour.

11. Stir in 170 g chopped pecans into cooled filling. Level cakes with a serrated knife if necessary; discard scraps or set aside for snacking. With serrated knife held so that blade is parallel with work surface, use sawing motion to cut each cake into two even layers. Remove parchment paper.
12. Place one layer on a turntable or serving platter. (If you'd like, a cardboard cake round can first be placed underneath, secured to the turntable with a scrap of damp paper towel.)

13. Top with 295 ml frosting. Using offset spatula, spread frosting evenly on cake layer to very edges of cake and level surface. Top with the second cake layer and repeat with 295 ml frosting. Carefully place final cake layer on top of filling; spread remaining filling (about 235 ml) over top. If necessary, dust crumbs off platter.
14. Decorate top border of cake with reserved 56 g pecans halves. Serve.
